target.docsQuery: Slack Web API chat.postMessage order summary fields

fieldMapping.note: Shopify order ID to include in the message text
Order total as a formatted string

assumptions: The webhook payload includes the standard Shopify order fields: id, name, email, total_price, currency, and line_items.
The integration has access to the Shopify shared secret to compute the HMAC-SHA256 digest for verification.
The Slack channel ID or name is known and configured in the Slack action step.
The message text is constructed by concatenating the mapped fields into a readable summary.

notes: Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature using the shared secret and raw request body.
Respond with 200 OK quickly to avoid retries.

Ensure raw body parsing is used (not JSON-parsed body) for HMAC verification.

notes: Requires chat:write scope on the bot token.
Text field is used as fallback when blocks are not present.
Message is posted as the bot user by default.
Channel can be specified by ID (e.g., C1234567890) or name (e.g., #orders).
Rate limited to ~1 message per second per channel.
